personajes.en: Afro-Caribbean raizal man, dark brown skin, short gray-flecked dreadlocks, yellow tee, khaki shorts, worn rubber sandals, carrying a plastic bucket with small fish and a hand net.
Raizal woman, brown skin, neat black braids with white beads, light blue uniform polo, white trousers, clean sneakers, holding a folded stack of white towels near a housekeeping cart.
Young mestizo man, olive skin, curly black hair, red tank top, denim shorts, flip-flops, shoulder sling bag, holding a straw hat up for sale, sunscreen patch on his nose.
Elderly raizal man, deep brown skin, white cropped hair, reading glasses, pastel linen shirt open over white undershirt, pressed beige trousers, leather loafers, walking stick and worn hymn book.

Wayuu woman, warm brown skin, long black braid, traditional woven multicolor Wayuu dress, beaded necklaces up to her collarbone, sandals, hands holding a half-finished mochila bag with crochet needle.
Wayuu man, brown skin, black hair tied back, thin chin beard, loose white shirt, dark trousers rolled to calves, open leather sandals, coiled lasso in hand, small herd stick across shoulder.
Mestizo man, tan skin, short black hair, faded black helmet strapped on, red Windbreaker jacket over shirt, jeans, sturdy sneakers, fingerless gloves, motorcycle keys and cracked phone for routes.

Elderly Wayuu woman, dark brown skin, deep wrinkles, long gray braid, black traditional machera dress with vivid woven patterns, beaded bracelets, walking with wooden cane, small cloth pouch of medicinal herbs.
